imm.ant_introText: Turquoise coves, ancient cities, pine forests and world-class resorts — let someone who lives here, not an agency brochure, show you Antalya.
imm.ant_streetTitle: Walk the streets before you arrive
imm.ant_streetIntro: From the narrow cobblestones of Kaş to the ancient gates of Kaleiçi — step right inside with Street View.
imm.ant_streetHint: ↻ Drag to look around 360° · use arrows to walk the street
imm.ant_ctaTitle: Let's build your Antalya plan together
imm.ant_ctaText: Send us your dates and we'll prepare a route just for you.
imm.les_puzzleDesc: Drag the letters and build the word. Correct letters lock into place — learn Turkish by playing.
imm.edu_s1Text: Which city, which university, which program? We narrow it down together, based on your goals and budget.
imm.edu_s1b: Program, language of study and city
imm.edu_s2Text: We prepare your applications step by step — including Türkiye Scholarships — without missing a deadline.
imm.edu_s3Text: Equivalency, visa, flights and your first week — you won't be left alone when you land.
imm.edu_s4Text: Dorm or apartment? Transport, groceries, the beach… we explain student life in Antalya from the inside.
imm.edu_streetTitle: Walk the campus and the city
imm.edu_streetIntro: From the Akdeniz University campus to Konyaaltı and Lara — explore where you'll study and live with Street View, right now.
imm.ab_story1Text: One of us is a senior software engineer — we built PetLingo and this platform from scratch. We've followed Antalya, its hotels and tourism closely for years; we make things easy with technology and keep everything transparent.
imm.ab_story2Text: The other of us is from Kazakhstan. She came to Turkey and walked the university and scholarship path herself; now she teaches Turkish like a native. She lived this road from application to the first winter day — and will guide you through the very same.
imm.ab_v1Text: You talk to a real person, not a faceless agency.
imm.ab_v2Text: Turkish, English, Russian, Kazakh and Uzbek.
imm.ab_v3Text: Guidance from someone who has truly done what you're about to do.
imm.con_findText: We're around Kaleiçi and the Old Harbor — explore the area on the map before you arrive.
imm.lol_takeYou: It's not ours — but on your dream holiday, we'll take you here too.
imm.les_processTitle: From zero to speaking, with someone beside you
imm.les_processDesc: Learn Turkish not with a single app, but with a native teacher + daily practice in your pocket. Here's your step-by-step path.
imm.les_teacher_title: Native Kazakh & Russian, C2 Turkish and English
imm.les_teacher_text: Your one-on-one speaking lessons are taught by an experienced teacher who has lived in Turkey for 10+ years and knows Antalya and its surroundings —including the hotels— inside out. We start in your language and move into Turkish together, step by step.
imm.les_p1Text: We figure out where you are together — a personal plan for your goal.
imm.les_p2Text: With a native Turkish teacher on Zoom or face-to-face in Antalya.
imm.les_p3Text: Between lessons, gamified spaced repetition with PetLingo.
imm.les_p4Text: Real conversation practice; visible progress every week.
imm.pl_desc: With adorable pets, like playing a game. Reinforce what you learn in lessons inside PetLingo — spaced repetition won't let you forget, and TTS helps you pronounce it right.
imm.pl_soon: Coming soon to App Store & Google Play
imm.pl_combo: App + live lessons = the fastest path
imm.sell_eyebrow: Not a package — made for you
imm.sell_title: We don't sell everyone the same thing
imm.sell_text: You write, we listen. We build the plan from scratch around your dates, budget, dream holiday or study goal — no copy-paste packages. With real people who live in Antalya and studied in Turkey, in your own language.
imm.sell_b1: A plan prepared just for you — not copy-paste
imm.sell_b2: One contact: the same person start to finish
imm.sell_b3: In your language: TR · EN · RU · KK · UZ
imm.lived_title: We achieved every service we offer ourselves first
imm.lived_text: We studied on scholarships, taught Turkish and live in Antalya. We also built the PetLingo app ourselves. We don't guide from theory — we walked this path ourselves, and our team truly knows it.

about.title: About us
about.body: We're a small family based in Antalya. One of us is a senior software engineer who built the PetLingo app and this whole platform, and knows Antalya and its tourism inside out. The other is from Kazakhstan: she came to Turkey, walked the university path herself, speaks Turkish like a native and now teaches it. We give what agencies rarely do: honest, personal, multilingual guidance from people who have actually lived it.
